travels: Chicken pieces might travel if kept apart from the chip and crema.
does_not_travel: Assembled chip under hot chicken goes soft within the dine-in 10-minute gate; the chip likely will not travel.
packaging_must_solve: Separate chip, chicken and crema; vent steam; no trapped moisture; keep safe temperature.
tests_that_matter: T+10 / T+20 / T+30 holds of separated and assembled forms; crispness, chicken temperature and sogginess recorded.
dine_in_protection: Do not market takeout as the same dish; keep the assembled plate dine-in only unless a test proves otherwise.

travels: Paneer and salsa might travel separately; tortilla assembly after arrival.
does_not_travel: Assembled taco: paneer firms and tortilla steams or tears.
packaging_must_solve: Separate warm paneer, tortilla and salsa; keep tortilla warm and dry.
tests_that_matter: T+10 / T+20 / T+30 holds of paneer firmness, tortilla tear and char; tortilla re-warm test.
dine_in_protection: Dine-in remains the finished-to-order version; takeout is an unassembled kit if ever.

travels: Braise and consomme could travel hot in separate sealed containers; strongest candidate.
does_not_travel: Dipped griddled taco goes soft; fat set in cold consomme.
packaging_must_solve: Hot-hold or chill-and-reheat rules set by a food-safety professional; leak-proof consomme; tortillas separate.
tests_that_matter: T+10 / T+20 / T+30 holds of braise and consomme temperature, fat set and tortilla texture; reheat test.
dine_in_protection: Dine-in keeps fresh griddled and dipped service; takeout avoids the claim of the full experience.

travels: Roasted/fried florets might travel dry or steam in a closed container; glaze and dip may separate.
does_not_travel: Glazed florets soften quickly in a closed container.
packaging_must_solve: Separate glaze/dip and florets; vent the container; limit steam.
tests_that_matter: T+10 / T+20 / T+30 holds of crunch and glaze softening; re-crisp test. DESIGN ASSUMPTION - UNTESTED.
dine_in_protection: Dine-in remains glaze-to-order; takeout is a kit with a clear assembly note (appetizer/shareable, no tortilla).

travels: Quesadilla may travel acceptably if vented; dip separate.
does_not_travel: Steamed in closed container, it softens and the cheese cools and firms.
packaging_must_solve: Vent, avoid stacking, separate dip; check filling leak and cheese set.
tests_that_matter: T+10 / T+20 / T+30 holds of crispness, leak, cheese set and filling temperature; reheat test.
dine_in_protection: Dine-in is fresh off the comal; takeout is labelled as a different experience.

travels: Cold drinks may travel if sealed and labelled; temperature and hold dependent.
does_not_travel: Fresh fruit, dairy or tea drinks may spoil; carbonation fades.
packaging_must_solve: Sealed, labelled, date-marked, cold chain; allergen label; clear NA marking.
tests_that_matter: T+10 / T+20 / T+30 checks of temperature, carbonation, flavor and separation; shelf-life review by a professional.
dine_in_protection: NA parity in the dine-in list must not shrink because takeout is hard.

travels: Legality of take-away alcohol is for a Texas alcohol attorney; nothing is assumed.
does_not_travel: Unknown until the attorney confirms what is allowed.
packaging_must_solve: Container, seal, labelling and age-check rules set by the attorney; no design here.
tests_that_matter: If allowed: T+10 / T+20 / T+30 temperature and carbonation holds of sealed product; otherwise no test.
dine_in_protection: Dine-in beer service and responsible-service standards must not weaken for takeout sales.
